propositions: Literal section-heading requirements falsely reject valid plans where mechanism is encoded in alternative headings or semantic aliases (counterexample: 003d lacks Approach but passes with executable What)
Placeholder-lexicon detectors produce false positives on mechanically bounded conditionals (counterexample: 03c6 check-if condition is decidable and fully specified, not deferred design)

Per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers are not necessary when behavioral assertions are precise enough to pass plan-review and completion-verifier (counterexample: 003d has five ACs with no marked proof coverage yet both attestations pass)

Edit-set requirements incorrectly apply to read-only analysis and external-attestation work with explicit no-edit contracts (counterexample: 0730 analysis probe is closed PASS with empty file_impact by design)

Deterministic AC conjunction counts cannot distinguish bundled independent deliverables from atomic matrices and should remain advisory only (counterexample: 090f final AC bundles compatible test coverage for multiple attestation states)

Hard Testing-section structure requirements falsely trigger on mechanical migrations and infrastructure work where user-facing scenario taxonomy is inapplicable (counterexample: 35bc has Testing section with no failure/boundary markers yet passes both attestations)
